items.prompt: Edit image 1, an independent hollow HAIR-ONLY object, using the woman in image 2 (Sun Ruowei in Ming Dynasty) for the visible hairstyle. Replace the low wide rounded braided crown and excessive pearl garlands with her distinctive tall upright compact braided hair arrangement: smoothly center-parted black front hair swept back, a raised narrow crown of interwoven braids at the top, a small understated gold ornament at the base of the high braid. No dangling pearl chains, no extra large flower ornaments, no fringe, no theatrical crown. No actor, no face, eyes, ears, neck, skin, face-shaped filler, mannequin or support: hollow open center shows the ivory background. Four equal isolated views of ONE SAME wig: front, three-quarter, strict side, back. Clearly show the height and braid structure in all views, consistent ornaments; generous blank gutters and margins, clean neutral ivory background, no text. Side, back and hidden joins are coherent creative design extensions, not exact documented screen reconstruction.
